nodes.text:
🚨 BREAKING: HMPV Virus Hits UP (India)! 🚨

A woman in Lucknow has tested positive for HMPV, a virus with symptoms similar to COVID-19.😷
She’s admitted to Hospital.
This is India’s 9th confirmed case of HMPV.
Here’s what you need to know about this alarming new threat. 🧵👇 https://t.co/WRbweabhIG

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
🔴 What’s Happening?
HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is spreading in India:
🦠2 cases in Karnataka
🦠2 in Nagpur
🦠2 in Tamil Nadu
🦠1 each in West Bengal, Gujarat, and now UP

Even CM Yogi held a high-level meeting two days ago to address this growing concern. ⚠️
#HMPV #HMPVindia

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
🔴 Why Should You Care?
HMPV symptoms are almost identical to COVID-19:
🤒 Fever
😮‍💨Cough
🫁 Breathing issues
👃 Runny nose

It’s especially dangerous for children, elderly, and people with weak immunity.
And just like COVID, it spreads through droplets!
#HealthCrisis

nodes.author: Welnesschick
nodes.text: @sehatkhabar Covid is airborne, not just droplet.

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
❌ What You Should Avoid
🚫 Don’t ignore cold or flu-like symptoms.
🚫 Don’t visit crowded places unnecessarily.
🚫 Don’t rely on antibiotics — they don’t work on viruses!
#HMPV #VirusAlert

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
✅ What You Should Do
🧼 Wash hands frequently.
😷 Wear masks in public places.
💧 Stay hydrated.
🏠 Isolate if you feel unwell.
#StaySafe

nodes.author: sehatkhabar
nodes.text:
💡 Stay Informed, Stay Safe!
The spread is real and dangerous.
🚨 Early detection and prevention are the only ways to stay ahead.
Help us spread awareness by sharing this post!

👉 Follow @sehatkhabar for more updates.
🔄 Retweet to protect your loved ones!

#SehatKhabar
